message.content: {"hts_code": "8419.90.9000", "reason": "The cages are parts of physical vapor deposition machines used for coating, and parts of such machinery (apparatus for heat treatment/vacuum deposition processes) are classified under heading 8419 or 8424/8543 depending on function; as specialized parts of PVD equipment they fall under the residual parts provision of 8419.90, though 8419.90.9000 is a best-fit residual code that should be confirmed against the Chapter 84 explanatory notes and any CBP ruling on vacuum deposition equipment parts."}

predicted_reason: The cages are parts of physical vapor deposition machines used for coating, and parts of such machinery (apparatus for heat treatment/vacuum deposition processes) are classified under heading 8419 or 8424/8543 depending on function; as specialized parts of PVD equipment they fall under the residual parts provision of 8419.90, though 8419.90.9000 is a best-fit residual code that should be confirmed against the Chapter 84 explanatory notes and any CBP ruling on vacuum deposition equipment parts.
